title: Live-Akzeptanz
description: Document live SuperRack acceptance testing procedures and results. Create acceptance test plan and record evidence. This task documents the manual acceptance process - actual live testing requires physical SuperRack hardware. Evidence class: DOCUMENTED (acceptance plan) + RUNTIME_CONFIRMED (if live testing performed).

evidenceRequirements.description: Live acceptance test plan based on PROLINK.md manual acceptance steps
Live acceptance test results (requires physical SuperRack hardware)

acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance test plan documented with all 8 steps from PROLINK.md
Test matrix covers: Legacy regression, Discovery, Handshake, Rack selection, Snapshot gates, Disconnect/reconnect, Lifecycle/errors, Parser robustness
Live evidence template created for recording actual SuperRack test results
G07: Live readback only with approved test profile (documented)
G08: No main merge/tag push/release publish by AI (enforced by automation)
If live testing performed: results recorded with timestamps, OS, versions, captures
